title: Splitting of the d orbitals in an octahedral complex
caption: Six ligands approaching along the axes repel the d orbitals that point at them (eg: dz² and dx²−y²) more than those between the axes (t₂g). The gap is Δo. Ti³⁺ (d¹) puts its single electron in t₂g; absorbing light promotes it to eg.
alt: Energy diagram: two eg orbitals above three t₂g orbitals, with the gap Δo; one electron in t₂g for Ti³⁺.
description: Lower: t₂g, three orbitals, holding one electron for Ti³⁺.
The gap between them is Δo.
